 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
ORDER The applicant has filed this SECOND bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 23.09.2022 in Crime No.525/2022 by Police Station - Gautam Nagar, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376(2)(i) of the IPC read with Section 3/ 4 of the P.O.C.S.O. Act.
His first application was dismissed as withdrawn on 6.1.2023.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is suffering confinement since 23.09.2022 and material prosecution witnesses / prosecutrix has been examined and she did not support the story of the prosecution and has been declared hostile, therefore, chance of tampering with the evidence/ witnesses is remote.
It is further submitted that the applicant does not bear any criminal record.
Confinement amounts to pre-trial detention.
The applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial/ investigation and would not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the prosecutrix in any manner.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for bail.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for it's dismissal.
4. Learned counsel for the complainant submits that he has no objection if bail is granted to the applicant.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
6 .
Considering the submissions and the nature of allegations, but without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
